summary: Completed testing of two new features: (1) User visibility filtering by role on GET /api/users - Admin sees only Admin/Manager/Super_Admin users (3 users), Super Admin sees ALL users including role=User (30 users). (2) Permission change audit logging - audit log entries created on template updates with module label, from/to values, timestamps. All 9 backend tests passed. Frontend verified Activity Log section with Template badges, change pills, and timestamps.

issues: React warning: Each child in a list should have a unique 'key' prop - minor console warning

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/users with Super_Admin auth token returns ALL users (30 users including role=User)
Backend: GET /api/users with Admin auth token returns ONLY Admin/Manager/Super_Admin users (filtered, no role=User)
Backend: GET /api/users without auth returns all users (backward compatibility)
Backend: GET /api/admin/module-permissions/audit-log returns audit entries with logs and total count
Backend: Audit log entry structure contains action, timestamp, role, changes fields
Backend: PUT /api/admin/module-permissions/templates/admin creates audit log entry with changes diff
Backend: Audit log changes contain module key, label (human-readable), from value, to value
Backend: Audit log pagination works with limit and skip parameters
Backend: Audit log changes have correct module labels (e.g., 'Broadcasts' not 'broadcasts')
Frontend: Module Permissions page loads with Activity Log section at bottom
Frontend: Activity Log shows Template badges for template_update actions
Frontend: Activity Log shows role name (e.g., 'Admin') next to badge
Frontend: Activity Log shows change pills with up/down arrows indicating enabled/disabled
Frontend: Activity Log shows relative timestamps (e.g., '1m ago', '4m ago')
Frontend: Admin login (testadmin@munal.com) shows filtered Users list - 3 users (Admin/Manager/Super_Admin only)
Frontend: Super Admin login (admin@munal.com) shows all 30 users including regular app users with role=User
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AdminUserManagementPage has React key prop warning for list items - should add unique key to mapped elements
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two features tested: (1) User visibility filtering - GET /api/users now filters based on caller role from auth token. Admin/Manager see only Admin/Manager/Super_Admin users. Super_Admin sees all users. Unauthenticated requests see all users (backward compatibility). (2) Permission audit log - stored in 'permission_audit_log' collection. Entries created on template updates and user overrides. Frontend Activity Log section shows entries with Template/User Override badges, role names, change pills with arrows, and relative timestamps. Cookie consent banner may overlap audit log section (pre-existing UI element).
